resources.string: Weather data from %1$s (%2$s). This app works out the drying advice from that data, with fixed rules that run on your phone. It uses no AI and contacts no other service.
The place you choose stays on this device. This app sends Open-Meteo, the weather service, only the place's rough coordinates and your searches. A search also includes your phone's language.
If you use your approximate location, your phone's location service finds it. The phone's maker or Google may run that service, which this app doesn't control.
Location permission is off. Search instead, or allow it in Settings.
Location is off on this device. Search instead, or turn it on and try again.
Couldn't get a location. Search instead, or try again.
